findings.title: Corrected v4 accepts overwhelmingly non-converged calibrations
findings.impact: Developer values, bootstrap E_cal, material labels, and v4 detection metrics depend on optimizer-unqualified fits.
findings.resolution_required: Classify v4 confirmatory gates PARTIAL, or run a new pre-frozen untouched-seed study with release-conformant calibration and frozen convergence/admissibility criteria. Do not tune or overwrite v4.

findings.title: Measured real and synthetic programs do not implement frozen release optimizer O01
findings.impact: Real and locked v4 metrics are method-variant evidence, not clean validation evidence for frozen Developer Model Release v1.0.
findings.resolution_required: Execute C04/O01/unconstrained for applicable studies and a new locked design, or version/freeze the actually executed methodology before new locked evaluation.

findings.title: Evidence gates can pass failed calibration and unresolved review findings
findings.impact: PASS labels do not currently establish scientific acceptability or full-release integrity.
findings.resolution_required: Gate calibration admissibility and release conformance, verify all release hashes, block unresolved Critical/High review findings, and order tests before final report/gate generation.

findings.title: PDE remains unqualified in difficult regimes
findings.impact: PDE cannot serve as a qualified independent valuation oracle.
findings.resolution_required: Keep Numerical/Independence acceptance PARTIAL, retain use limitation, and do not weaken tolerances.

findings.title: Canonical truth qualification wording overstates LocalVol/regime scope
findings.resolution_required: Describe these as qualified marginal controlled DGP constructions unless independently validating Dupire/regime-switch dynamics.

findings.title: F04-F16 are primarily controlled perturbation proxies
findings.resolution_required: Retain controlled-proxy terminology and avoid generalization to actual pipeline-engine faults.

findings.title: GPU QE-M lacks a direct CPU/GPU agreement test
findings.resolution_required: Add a bounded distributional/common-case QE-M CPU/GPU and martingale-parity check.

findings.title: Confirmatory uncertainty intervals are small-sample descriptive intervals
findings.resolution_required: Qualify inference as descriptive; consider more replicates and fault-stratified resampling in a future frozen study.

test_evidence.setup_error_cause: Windows pytest temporary-directory ACL; no assertion failure in the seven affected tests
